sentences.en: Today, I want to talk about this list I've been working on for, I think like over the past month or so, the list of 15 things I think everybody should do in their 20s.
sentences.zh: 今天，我想聊聊我一直在列的一张清单，我想大概有一个多月了吧，这是我认为每个人在20多岁时都应该做的15件事的清单。

sentences.en: The 15 things that may not be the most widely applauded achievements or milestones that society wants you to celebrate, but which I think will help us make the most of this decade
sentences.zh: 这15件事可能不是社会希望你庆祝的那些最受赞誉的成就或里程碑，但我认为它们将帮助我们充分利用这十年，

sentences.en: and enter our 30s and enter the rest of our lives feeling like we really did and saw and directed our lives in like the best possible way.
sentences.zh: 并在进入30岁以及余生时，觉得我们确实以最好的方式经历、见证并主导了自己的生活。

sentences.en: I obviously think about my 20s, our 20s a lot as a concept and as like an important life chapter.
sentences.zh: 我显然经常把20多岁、我们的20多岁作为一个概念以及人生中一个重要的章节来思考。

sentences.en: But I especially think about how to make the most of them.
sentences.zh: 但我尤其思考的是如何充分利用它们。

sentences.en: This decade feels kind of like the last time when we're truly able to experiment, take risks, make mistakes, get away with things.
sentences.zh: 这十年感觉就像是我们真正能够去实验、去冒险、去犯错、去逃脱惩罚的最后一段时期。

sentences.en: Obviously, like life continues after our 20s and we are able to reinvent ourselves until the day we die and able to take risks until the day we die.
sentences.zh: 当然，20多岁之后生活还在继续，直到生命的尽头我们都能够重新塑造自我，直到生命的尽头我们都能够去冒险。

sentences.en: But I do think there are some experiences that are really crucial just to have during this decade, if not for the first time, the only time.
sentences.zh: 但我确实认为，有些经历在这十年里是绝对至关重要的，即使不是第一次，也是唯一的一次。

sentences.en: And they leave a very, very sizable impact on us.
sentences.zh: 它们会在我们身上留下非常、非常深远的影响。

sentences.en: I also think again, like that list or milestone checklist that society tends to feed us where we have to graduate, find our dream job, find our life partner,
sentences.zh: 我也再次认为，社会往往灌输给我们的那种清单或里程碑核对表——比如我们必须毕业、找到梦想的工作、找到人生的伴侣、

sentences.en: get married, buy a house, maybe have a baby, live happily ever after is also very outdated.
sentences.zh: 结婚、买房、也许生个孩子、然后过上幸福快乐的生活——也已经非常过时了。

sentences.en: And despite its best intentions, I think those milestones miss the mark and they actually miss a lot of experiences that are just as important.
sentences.zh: 尽管它怀有最好的意愿，但我认为那些里程碑并未击中要害，它们实际上忽略了许多同样重要的经历。

sentences.en: So today for our 400th episode, I have rounded up the experiences, lessons, bucket list items that I think are most essential to do in our 20s or to have some kind of contact with
sentences.zh: 所以在今天这第400期节目中，我汇总了那些我认为在20多岁时最应当完成，或者应当与之有所接触的经历、经验和人生愿望清单，

sentences.en: in our 20s.
sentences.zh: 在我们的20多岁里。

sentences.en: It's not going to be the traditional checklist that you think of.
sentences.zh: 它不会是你想象中的那种传统清单。

sentences.en: It's definitely going to be a bit more unconventional.
sentences.zh: 它绝对会更加不落俗套一些。

sentences.en: So if you are finding that, you know, your 20s aren't going according to plan, I think if you're able to check some of these things off this list, you are doing an incredible job.
sentences.zh: 所以如果你发现，你知道，你的20多岁并没有按计划进行，我想如果你能完成这份清单上的某些事情，你已经做得非常棒了。

sentences.en: And I think it will help us and it has helped me making this list know where to direct my attention to outside of love, outside of my career, outside of financial goals,
sentences.zh: 而且我认为它会帮助我们——它也曾帮过我——在制作这份清单时，知道除了爱情、除了事业、除了财务目标之外，该把注意力转向哪里，

sentences.en: which is very, very important for our development in this decade.
sentences.zh: 这对于我们在这十年的发展中是非常、非常重要的。

sentences.en: So without further ado, let's get into the 15 best things you need to do in your 20s.
sentences.zh: 闲话少说，让我们切入你在20多岁时需要做的15件最好的事情。

sentences.en: Okay, so let's start with some of my more basic run-of-the-mill items that I put on this list before we get into some of the more controversial ones.
sentences.zh: 好的，在我们讨论那些更具争议性的项目之前，让我们先从一些我放在这份清单上的、更基础、更大众化的项目开始。

sentences.en: The first big one is just to live away from home.
sentences.zh: 第一件大事就是离开家去生活。

sentences.en: And I don't mean home in terms of like your childhood home or move out of your parents' house.
sentences.zh: 我指的“家”并不是指你童年的家或者搬出父母的房子。

sentences.en: That's obviously an amazing start and this will require you to do that.
sentences.zh: 这显然是一个极好的开始，而且这也需要你这么做。

sentences.en: I do mean more like live away from the city, the region, the town that feels like your place.
sentences.zh: 我的意思更倾向于是离开那个让你觉得熟悉、有归属感的城市、地区和城镇。

sentences.en: Even if that place is New York City or Beijing or London or like one of the biggest cities in the world, there are still opportunities a place like that

sentences.en: friendship opportunities.
